Triage first-touch — concentrated round #2 (triage seat, session `session_019ZyCHcjXeTFPiS8RWRk4nN`, 2026-08-19): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` · Task, with a seat adjudication of the A/B ownership fork (`auto-adjudicated`, veto window open — mechanical-boundary test: behaviour-preserving convergence, no accept-set or public-contract change; route A, which WOULD touch the spec contract, is explicitly not chosen here).

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- **Platform long-term coherence**: one exported `MetadataLockState` alias with both interfaces deriving from it beats two hand unions; B does not preclude a later spec-owned enum (A) — if spec ever grows one, the alias becomes a one-line re-export, so B is a way-station, not a workaround.
- **Measured business pull**: zero — four states complete, copies identical, dormant.
- **AI-agent error-resistance**: B turns "fifth state" from a silently-blank banner into a compile-time red (keyed lookup / exhaustive `satisfies` switch at `ResourceEditPage`), matching the strictness the audit panel already has after PR #5023.
- **Startup scope discipline**: B is a small local PR; A is cross-repo contract work for a dormant surface with no pull — exactly what the focus principle defers.

**Ruling: route B** — single exported `MetadataLockState` in `data-objectstack`, both declarations derive from it, and the `ResourceEditPage` banner's three `&&` branches become an exhaustive keyed lookup so an unknown state can never render an empty title. Route A (spec-owned `z.enum`) stays recorded as the future candidate and **must go to the maintainer** if pursued (contract-surface addition). Confidence gap: whether the wire can already carry values outside the four (older/newer servers) is unmeasured — the exhaustive lookup should therefore also handle the genuinely-unknown value loudly rather than only satisfying the compiler.

Size/model suggestion: S–M, sonnet.

**Thread read before dispatch.** The disposition is already adjudicated (`auto-adjudicated`, 2026-08-19) and you are implementing, not choosing:

> **Ruling: route B** — single exported `MetadataLockState` in `data-objectstack`, both declarations derive from it, and the `ResourceEditPage` banner's three `&&` branches become an exhaustive keyed lookup so an unknown state can never render an empty title.

⛔ **Route A (a spec-owned `z.enum`) is explicitly NOT chosen** and stays recorded as a future candidate that **must go to the maintainer** if pursued — it is contract-surface work. If your measurement suggests A, stop and report; do not take it.

**Clause ②:** cleared by the ruling on its own stated ground — behaviour-preserving convergence, no accept-set or public-contract change. If the implementation turns out to move an accept set, that is a different card: stop and report.

**The ruling's own confidence gap is your sharpest obligation.** Triage recorded that *whether the wire can already carry values outside the four (older/newer servers) is unmeasured*, and concluded: **the exhaustive lookup should handle a genuinely-unknown value LOUDLY rather than only satisfying the compiler.** A `satisfies`-style exhaustiveness check that is compile-time-only leaves the runtime blank banner exactly as it is today — which is the defect. Measure whether an out-of-vocabulary value can reach the banner, and say what a user sees when it does.

**Give the pin a control that can fail.** An exhaustiveness assertion is satisfied by the current four whether or not the runtime path is fixed, so a green type-check proves nothing on its own. Add a leg that feeds a fifth value through the real render path and measure it.

⛔ OUT: `packages/types/**` + `packages/core/src/types/**` (#4972 this round), `packages/components/**` + `packages/react-runtime/**` + `content/docs/**` (#5469), `packages/plugin-calendar/**` (#5045).
